text:
emily-sales: Heads-up — MerchantWave POC just hit 429s during a UI-driven import demo. Their execs are watching in 30m. Need a fast triage.

chris-eng: Paste a sample error and headers please. Which endpoint?

emily-sales: From their frontend:```
POST /v1/embeddings 429
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1800
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 60
Retry-After: 60
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","tenant":"merchantwave-poc","route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```They're firing ~30 concurrent embed calls (~70 tokens each).

zara-ml: This pattern is common: many tiny parallel calls exhaust the per-route token budget. Quick options: client batching, or temporary quota bump. Also consider a small proxy that aggregates UI events into fewer multi-input embedding calls — low lift on customer side.

leo-ops: I can apply a short reservation. Proposal: increase per-route tokens/min to 10k for merchantwave-poc, enable server-side queueing max_concurrency=8, TTL=2.5h. That should let the demo finish. Approve?

emily-sales: Customer approved temporary lift in DM. Please proceed — they want no interruptions. Also flag billing.

quota-bot: quota-service: reservation applied by leo-ops for tenant=merchantwave-poc route=/v1/embeddings tokens_per_min=10000 ttl=2.5h id=resv_px9.

chris-eng: After bump I'm seeing queueing kick in; retries are smoothing. For post-demo follow-ups: (1) share a tiny proxy snippet that batches client events into a single /v1/embeddings call, (2) add a presales checklist advising concurrency caps and exponential backoff, (3) propose console UX to allow short-term reservations for sales users (audit trail required).

zara-ml: I'll prepare a one-pager on embedding best practices (batching examples + model cost guidance) to attach to presales docs.

leo-ops: Saved metrics for the window and will auto-revert at TTL unless extended.

emily-sales: Replay now — demo stable, only occasional Retry-After spikes. Customer pleased. Thanks team :tada:

chris-eng: Quick note for tickets: tag under presales-pocs and product-request (console-reservations).

emily-sales: Closing loop with MerchantWave and sending a short note on long-term options (proxy/batching or reserved capacity).
